author: Ari Koslow
title: Steven Matz (ankle) to begin rehab assignment Thursday
desc: Steven Matz is scheduled to begin a rehab assignment on Thursday.
impact: Matz should be activated at some point later in July after the All-Star break.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Jhony Brito has locker in Padres clubhouse
desc: Jhony Brito has a locker in the Padres clubhouse.
impact: There should be an official roster move announced before first pitch.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Giancarlo Stanton (calf) remains without timetable to return
desc: Giancarlo Stanton remains without a clear timetable to return.
impact: Stanton has yet to resume running. He is doing treadmill work. The expectation remains that he will be back this season, but when that is remains an uncertainty.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Jeremy Pena (calf) to begin rehab assignment Tuesday
desc: Jeremy Pena will begin a rehab assignment on Tuesday with Triple-A Sugar Land.
impact: Pena will figure to require playing in a handful of rehab games. He could be activated shortly after the All-Star break.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Cole Henry recalled from Triple-A
desc: The Nationals recalled RHP Cole Henry from Triple-A Rochester.
impact: Henry will hold a middle-relief role in the Nationals bullpen.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Mason Englert optioned to Triple-A
desc: The Rays optioned RHP Mason Englert to Triple-A Durham.
impact: Englert allowed two runs in 5 2/3 innings while striking out nine in a loss to the Astros on Sunday. He should get another opportunity later in the summer.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Chris Roycroft recalled from Triple-A
desc: The Rays recalled RHP Chris Roycroft from Triple-A Durham.
impact: Roycroft will hold a middle-relief role in the Rays bullpen.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Raynel Delgado optioned to Triple-A
desc: The Astros optioned INF Raynel Delgado to Triple-A Sugar Land.
impact: Delgado heads back to Triple-A with Braden Shewmake activated from the injured list.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Braden Shewmake activated from IL
desc: The Astros activated INF Braden Shewmake from the 10-day injured list.
impact: Shewmake missed the last month with a right adductor strain. He is back at shortstop and batting eighth on Monday.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Jacob Young (hand) in lineup Monday
desc: Jacob Young is in the Nationals lineup on Monday against the Astros.
impact: Young returns from a two-game absence due to left hand soreness. He is back in center field.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Jazz Chisholm Jr. (toe) in lineup Monday
desc: Jazz Chisholm Jr. is in the Yankees lineup on Monday against the Rays.
impact: Chisholm left Sunday's series finale against the Twins with right big toe discomfort. He is back at second base and hitting sixth.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Max Rajcic (elbow) placed on IL
desc: The Cardinals placed Max Rajcic on the 15-day injured list with right elbow soreness.
impact: Rajcic does not hold a timetable to return. He will head for further evaluation.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Gordon Graceffo recalled from Triple-A
desc: The Cardinals recalled RHP Gordon Graceffo from Triple-A Memphis.
impact: Graceffo will return to a middle-relief role in the Cardinals bullpen.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Edwin Uceta (shoulder) to be re-evaluated
desc: Edwin Uceta is headed for further evaluation and remains shut down from throwing.
impact: Uceta has been on the injured list with lingering shoulder issues since spring training. He remains without a clear timetable to return with an update likely being provided within the next week.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Jair Camargo designated for assignment
desc: The Braves designated C Jair Camargo for assignment.
impact: Camargo will likely pass through waivers unclaimed and remain in the Braves organization.
